title: PF1e combat profile
description: The ```combat-profile block in a stat block or character sheet, read by scripts/combat.py. How to translate a PF1e stat block into it: library/pf1e/combat-profile-guide.md. Check a file with: python3 scripts/combat.py -c <campaign> profile check <file>.

kind.description: Always 'creature' here: NPCs, monsters and DM-run allies (the DM rolls their attacks). Player characters use combat-profile-pc.schema.json.

hp.description: Hit points as listed (a PC's current HP lives on the sheet's HP line).

cmb_vs.description: CMB for specific maneuvers, from the stat block's parentheses: 'CMB +5 (+7 trip)' -> {"trip": 7}. combat.py doesn't add Improved/Greater feat bonuses itself.

cmd_vs.description: CMD against specific maneuvers: 'CMD 17 (21 vs. trip)' -> {"trip": 21} (Improved feats, extra legs).

maneuver_immune.description: Maneuvers that can't affect it: 'can't be tripped', oozes and legless or flying creatures (trip), etc.

save_notes.description: Conditional save bonuses, e.g. '+2 vs. fear'. Not automated: the DM applies them.

ac_notes.description: Conditional AC bonuses, e.g. '+4 dodge vs. giants'.

size.description: Squares per side: 1 = Medium or smaller, 2 = Large, 3 = Huge, 4 = Gargantuan.

reach.description: Natural reach in feet (the second number of Space/Reach).

dr.description: Damage reduction amount (hardness for objects). combat.py subtracts it from every hit.

dr_bypass.description: What overcomes the DR, e.g. 'magic', 'silver', 'cold iron/good', '-' for DR x/-. Not automated yet.

resist.description: Energy resistance, e.g. {"fire": 10}. Not automated yet.

sr.description: Spell resistance: spells and spell-like abilities with "sr": true must beat it with a caster level check (1d20 + CL; library/pf1e/rules/spell-resistance.md).

str.description: Strength score. Conditions that change Str (fatigued, exhausted, paralyzed) recompute melee attacks and damage from it.

dex.description: Dexterity score (extra AoOs with Combat Reflexes). Conditions that change Dex (grappled, entangled, fatigued, helpless, …) recompute AC, touch, flat-footed AC, Reflex and ranged attacks from it.

max_dex.description: The armor's (or shield's) max Dex bonus, if it caps the Dex bonus in AC. Needed so a Dex penalty doesn't lower AC when the cap already limits it.

feats.description: At least those the script uses: Combat Reflexes, Precise Shot, Improved Initiative. Listing all is fine.

improved_uncanny_dodge.description: can't be flanked (except by a rogue 4+ levels higher)

sneak_attack.description: Sneak attack dice, e.g. '2d6' (ceil(rogue level / 2) d6). combat.py adds them when the target is flanked or denied its Dex, without concealment; ranged only within 30 ft; never multiplied on a crit.

wielding.description: the attacks (weapons) it holds when a fight starts, e.g. ["rapier"] or ["composite longbow"]; default: its first weapon. Natural attacks are always at hand

bab.description: base attack bonus: with +1 or more, drawing a weapon rides on a move action (default +1)

tactics.description: How this creature likes to fight, as weights on the turn plans in the tactical options (points of expected damage: +3 is a clear preference, -3 a clear aversion). Plan kinds: melee, ranged, spell (offensive spells, SLAs and abilities), buff, heal, defense (total defense), retreat (withdraw).

weights.description: Personality, e.g. a coward {"retreat": 2, "melee": -2}, a berserker {"melee": 4, "defense": -4}

morale.description: When morale breaks, these weights are added

hp.description: breaks at or below this share of its max HP, e.g. 0.5

allies_down.description: breaks when this share of its side is down (1 = all)

abilities.description: Supernatural (Su) and extraordinary (Ex) abilities the script can resolve (`combat.py ability`): bardic performances, channel energy, breath weapons, … Numbers worked out for this creature. Spell-like abilities (Sp) go in 'sla'.

type.description: supernatural (Su, default) or extraordinary (Ex). Neither provokes, needs concentration or is subject to spell resistance; spell-like abilities (Sp) go in 'sla'. Su stops working in an antimagic field, Ex doesn't (not automated).

target.description: one creature (--target), an area (from the area template), or the user itself

center.description: a burst centred on the user (channel energy) or on a point within range

range.description: range in feet (to the target or the burst's centre); 0 = touch

dmg.description: damage dice at this creature's caster level, e.g. '2d4'

cond.description: condition on a failed save (or without a save), e.g. 'asleep'

immunity.description: After the effect, the target is immune to it for a while: daze {"rounds": 10, "from": "anyone", "after": "affected"}; a once-a-day hex {"rounds": 14400, "from": "caster", "after": "targeted"}. While immune, a single-target use is refused and an area skips it.

rounds.description: how long (a number, a formula of cl, or dice)

from.description: immune to everyone's use of it, or only that caster's

after.description: only once it took effect (failed save), or as soon as it was targeted

cond_mods.description: modifiers of a custom condition (one the script doesn't know, e.g. evil eye)

who.description: who an area affects (default: everyone in it)

allies.description: a buff: modifiers for the allies it reaches

buff_rounds.description: how long a buff lasts (performances: 1, refreshed while maintained)

attack.description: the touch attack bonus (ranged touch for a ray: BAB + Dex mod; melee touch: BAB + Str mod), rolled against touch AC before the effect lands

maintain.description: a performance: the action to keep it going each round

uses.description: uses per day (rounds per day for a performance)

senses.description: Vision and other senses, from the stat block's Senses line and weaknesses. Ranges in feet.

perception.description: Perception modifier (Senses line). Used to decide how far a creature notices others in plain sight (take 10).

skills.description: Skill modifiers the script rolls itself.

heal.description: Heal modifier for first aid (DC 15), a healer's kit's +2 included; untrained: its Wis modifier (default +0)

aoo.description: AoOs per round, only if it differs from the rules (1, +Dex with Combat Reflexes).

attacks.description: One entry per distinct attack. Required for kind creature (may be empty for a creature that doesn't attack).

bonus.description: Total attack bonus; a list for iterative attacks (+6/+1 -> [6, 1]).

damage.description: Dice expression, e.g. '1d8+4'. Riders go in 'rider'.

touch.description: A touch attack (e.g. a spell or incorporeal touch).

crit.description: Lowest number of the threat range: /19-20 -> 19. Default 20.

range.description: Range increment in feet. Required for ranged and thrown attacks (from the weapon table).

hands.description: hands it takes to wield (bows and two-handed weapons 2; guessed from the name if left out)

natural.description: a natural attack (always at hand, never drawn); guessed from the name (bite, claw, slam…) if left out

supernatural.description: a supernatural or spell-like attack (a ray, a breath): always at hand, takes no hands, never threatens; guessed for ranged touch attacks named bolt, ray, blast… if left out

ammo.description: arrows/bolts/stones it carries, or how many of a thrown weapon (javelins); combat.py counts them

ability.description: Ability behind the attack roll, if not the default (Str for melee, Dex for ranged): 'dex' with Weapon Finesse, 'none' for e.g. a touch spell cast by ability-independent means.

str_damage.description: Str multiplier on damage, if not the default (1 for melee and thrown, 0 for other ranged): 1.5 two-handed or a sole natural attack, 0.5 off-hand or secondary natural attacks, 1 composite bow.

reach.description: Reach of this attack, if it differs from the creature's (e.g. a longspear).

rider.description: What happens on a hit besides damage, e.g. 'plus trip', 'plus poison (DC 13 Fort, 1d2 Str)', 'plus 1d6 fire'. Not automated: the DM applies it.

full_attack.description: Attack names used in a full attack, repeated as often as they're made ('2 claws' -> ['claw', 'claw']). Omit if the only full attack is one weapon's iterative bonuses.

spellcasting.description: One entry per spellcasting class or source.

concentration.description: The concentration bonus from the stat block (CL + casting ability modifier, plus feats).

dc_base.description: 10 + casting ability modifier; a spell's DC is dc_base + spell level.

slots.description: Spells per day by level (spontaneous), or the number of prepared spells per level (prepared). Level 0 is at will: use 99.

spells.description: Prepared: the prepared list, repeated per copy ('sleep' twice if prepared twice). Spontaneous: spells known.

effects.description: per spell, what differs from the library's spell effect for this caster (or a whole effect the library lacks). Spells in `spells` get their effect from library/pf1e/spells/<name>.md at this entry's cl, so most casters need no effects at all.

utility.description: no combat effect (detect magic): silences the missing-effect warning

sr_harmless.description: Spell Resistance: yes (harmless): an ally lowers its SR

additionalProperties.description: This caster's effect for the spell, merged over the library's ```spell-effect block (library/pf1e/spells/<name>.md): give only what differs (an 'attack' bonus for a touch spell, dmg_bonus), or a whole effect for a spell the library lacks. Numbers may be formulas of cl, ranges keywords (touch, close, medium, long). The resolved effect must pass library/pf1e/spell-effect.schema.json.

special.description: Other combat-relevant abilities in one line each, e.g. 'ferocity', 'pounce', 'grab (Medium)'. Not automated.

source.description: Where the numbers come from, e.g. 'Bestiary pg. 156'.
